about.text: New surfaces for Monitoring Tools, drawn in the Graphite look (Material 3 tonal surfaces on the Mint seed, Roboto with JetBrains Mono for figures). Every value shown is a working control where the app can change it. Sample disks, paths and figures are made up and safe. Use the Theme tweak on each board for light and dark.
